mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is currently 56 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Ridge Middle School and a third quarter moon overhead; expect an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain predicted.
Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to recognize the vital work of our Planning and Development Department in shaping our city's future through data-driven insights.
There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music tomorrow at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market on Saturday.
In a report regarding a retail theft on September 21, a suspect was identified via surveillance footage after taking items from a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.

The Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the evening after serving up Chocolate Heath Crunch, but we look forward to seeing you tomorrow morning at 10 AM when we feature Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
